description: Finds communities in an undirected graph by repeatedly removing the edge with highest unweighted betweenness until the requested count is reached. Use it to ask how a network separates into groups. Returns deterministic communities, their nodes and subgraph ids, sizes, and partition modularity.

graph_id.description: Id of the undirected graph to partition.

num_communities.description: Target number of communities, from 2 to 20.
